crossRefs.note: Therefore I command you to set apart three cities for yourselves.

translations.web: Therefore I command you to set apart three cities for yourselves.
translations.bsb: This is why I am commanding you to set apart for yourselves three cities.
translations.kjv: Wherefore I command thee, saying, Thou shalt separate three cities
translations.asv: Wherefore I command thee, saying, Thou shalt set apart three cities for thee.
